name: Queen

whyMatters.en: London four-piece formed in 1970. Multi-section songs, stacked studio vocals, and Brian May’s Red Special guitar define the mid-1970s catalog; A Night at the Opera (1975) is the central album.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦四人组，1970 年成立。多段体歌曲、录音室堆叠人声，以及 Brian May 的 Red Special 吉他，是 1970 年代中期目录的主要特征；《A Night at the Opera》（1975）是核心专辑。

note.en: From A Night at the Opera; ballad, opera-style vocal stack, then hard-rock outro. UK #1 single.
note.zh: 出自《A Night at the Opera》；谣曲、歌剧式人声堆叠，再接硬摇滚尾奏。英国单曲榜冠军。

note.en: From News of the World; stomp-stomp-clap body percussion and short guitar solo.
note.zh: 出自《News of the World》；跺脚-跺脚-拍手体感打击与短吉他独奏。

note.en: From Jazz; piano-led uptempo with stacked backing vocals and May’s Red Special.
note.zh: 出自《Jazz》；钢琴领衔快板，堆叠和声与 May 的 Red Special。

interviewQuotes.text: I always knew I was a star. And everyone else would know it soon.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Freddie Mercury

interviewQuotes.text: We're a rock group. We're not a prog band.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Brian May

lyricQuotes: Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy?
Don't stop me now, I'm having such a good time

shortBio.en: London hard rock / progressive rock, 1970–. Mercury, May, Taylor, Deacon; Bohemian Rhapsody and A Night at the Opera are the main mid-70s references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦硬摇滚 / progressive rock，1970 年至今。Mercury、May、Taylor、Deacon；《Bohemian Rhapsody》与《A Night at the Opera》是 70 年代中期主要参照。

body.en:
Queen formed in London in 1970. John Deacon joined on bass in 1971. The mid-1970s albums through News of the World (1977) combine Brian May’s layered Red Special guitar, Freddie Mercury’s piano and vocal range, and multi-track studio choirs.

Bohemian Rhapsody (1975) moved from ballad to opera-style vocal stacks to a hard-rock outro and reached UK #1. Later singles such as We Will Rock You and Don’t Stop Me Now use shorter forms suited to large venues. Live Aid 1985 is a widely cited live performance. After Mercury’s death in 1991, May and Taylor continued with guest vocalists; Deacon retired from public performance.
body.zh:
Queen 于 1970 年在伦敦成立。John Deacon 于 1971 年加入贝斯。70 年代中期至《News of the World》（1977）的专辑，结合 Brian May 的 Red Special 层叠吉他、Freddie Mercury 的钢琴与音域，以及多轨录音室合唱。

《Bohemian Rhapsody》（1975）从谣曲进入歌剧式人声堆叠，再接硬摇滚尾奏，并登上英国单曲榜冠军。之后的《We Will Rock You》、《Don’t Stop Me Now》等单曲采用更短、更适合大型场馆的结构。Live Aid 1985 是常被引用的现场演出。1991 年 Mercury 去世后，May 与 Taylor 与客座主唱继续演出；Deacon 退出公开演出。

body.en:
Queen’s mid-1970s records rely on stacked vocals, May’s delay-layered guitar, and song forms that change section by section within a single track.

A Night at the Opera (1975) is the clearest album-length example of that studio approach on commercial radio.
body.zh:
Queen 1970 年代中期录音以堆叠人声、May 的延时层叠吉他，以及单曲内部分段切换的曲式为主。

《A Night at the Opera》（1975）是这套录音室写法登上商业电台的最清晰专辑样本。

body.en:
Mercury handled piano and lead vocal drama. May supplied Red Special tone and layered guitar. Taylor played drums and high harmony. Deacon wrote bass-led hooks such as Another One Bites the Dust.

All four wrote; writing credits stay separate. The best-known catalog run is mid-1970s through The Game (1980).
body.zh:
Mercury 负责钢琴与主唱。May 提供 Red Special 音色与层叠吉他。Taylor 负责鼓与高和声。Deacon 写出如《Another One Bites the Dust》一类贝斯主导钩子。

四人都写歌，署名分开。最常被引用的目录区间是 70 年代中期至《The Game》（1980）。

body.en:
The song has no repeating chorus loop: a cappella intro, ballad, mock-opera vocal stack, then May’s hard-rock outro.

Tape editing and multi-track choir make the section changes literal. It was a UK #1 single in 1975–76.
body.zh:
这首歌没有重复副歌循环：无伴奏前奏、谣曲、假歌剧人声堆叠，再接 May 的硬摇滚尾奏。

磁带剪辑与多轨合唱把段落切换做成字面操作。1975–76 年登上英国单曲榜冠军。

title.en: News of the World and later singles

body.en:
News of the World (1977) shortens the arrangement: We Will Rock You uses body percussion; We Are the Champions is a slow anthem.

Don’t Stop Me Now (1978) keeps piano drive and choir stacks at a faster pop tempo. Same lineup; simpler live economy for arenas.
body.zh:
《News of the World》（1977）缩短编曲：《We Will Rock You》使用体感打击；《We Are the Champions》是慢颂歌。

《Don’t Stop Me Now》（1978）在更快的流行速度上保留钢琴驱动与合唱堆叠。同一阵容；为体育场换更简的现场编排。

body.en:
Mercury’s circulated lines emphasize stage presence. May’s interviews often name gear and arrangement choices.

Both sit next to the Red Special and the vocal-stack method on the records.
body.zh:
Mercury 流传短句强调舞台存在感。May 的采访常点名器材与编排选择。

两者都应对照唱片上的 Red Special 与人声堆叠来读。

title.zh: 后来体育场摇滚的引用

body.en:
Muse and other arena acts have cited multi-section forms and stacked vocals. Live Aid 1985 is often treated as a separate live reference from the album cycle.

In this catalog, Queen sit at hard-rock weight with progressive-form songwriting.
body.zh:
Muse 等体育场乐队曾引用多段体曲式与堆叠人声。Live Aid 1985 常被当作独立于专辑周期的现场参照。

在本目录中，Queen 落在 hard-rock 体量与 progressive 形式写作的交汇处。

note.en: Deacon joins 1971; Mercury active until 1991. Main catalog from A Night at the Opera through The Game.
note.zh: Deacon 1971 加入；Mercury 活跃至 1991。主要目录从《A Night at the Opera》到《The Game》。

note.en: May and Taylor continue with guest vocalists; Deacon retires from public performance.
note.zh: May 与 Taylor 与客座主唱续演；Deacon 退出公开演出。

note.en: Multi-section UK #1 single from A Night at the Opera.
note.zh: 出自《A Night at the Opera》的多段体英国单曲榜冠军。

note.en: Studio choir stacks with hard-rock guitar on 1970s commercial radio.
note.zh: 1970 年代商业电台上的录音室合唱堆叠与 hard-rock 吉他。
